posts.author: Howard_Bentley
posts.body:
For skill 2, I think you should be able to do something like this:
Code:
c = FORMULA ; c >= b.hp ? a.mp += a.mmp / 4 : c
Just replace "FORMULA" with your actual formula.
The only thing about this is that is doesn't account for crits, so if the enemy has 100 HP, and the skill would normally do 70, you won't get the MP if it KO's the enemy with a crit. Same thing applies with variance.
As for skill 4, you can use this:
Code:
a.buffs[param_id] <0 ? better_formula : weak_formula
but that's only checking for one debuff, unfortunately. I have no idea if you'd be able to check all debuffs at once.
Edit: I got skill 4 working! Here's the formula:
Code:
c = 1;a.buffs.each { |x| x<0 ? c = 2 : 0};c * (FORMULA)
Just add in your formula and change the "c = 2" if you want. You could even change the "c = 2" to c += 1 if you wanted the skill to deal increasing damage the more debuffs the user has.
Edit 2: skill 4 requires this scriptlet to work:
Code:
class Game_BattlerBase
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Public Instance Variables
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  attr_reader   :buffs
end
Just add the code into an empty slot below materials and above main.
